name: Marbas
source:
Marbas is Lucifer's most loyal subject.

His violence and libido, regardless of the fact of existence or nonexistence, are dangerous to both allies and enemies, so he cannot be freed from his restraints until Lucifer permits him. 

He is a mysterious contractor affiliated to Paradise Lost. Devils under Lucifer's command are difficult to understand, and it is indefinite to call them ally or foe.
